screen.lsmcore.windows.title: Projecting windows
screen.lsmcore.windows.width_help: Total opening width in blocks, including sash frames. Not occupied cell count.
screen.lsmcore.windows.height_help: Total opening height in blocks, including sash frames. Not occupied cell count.
screen.lsmcore.windows.columns_help: Positive integer count of leaves across. Four or more columns are allowed.
screen.lsmcore.windows.rows_help: Positive integer count of leaves vertically. Each leaf is limited to 3 x 3 blocks.
screen.lsmcore.windows.reset_help: Store the built-in 1 x 1 layout on this assembly only. Other windows and opening states stay unchanged.
screen.lsmcore.windows.draft_help: Edit the local draft. Only operators can save it to the world catalog.
screen.lsmcore.windows.timeout: No reply. Use Refresh to try again.
screen.lsmcore.windows.admin_help: Operator: edits affect the catalog, not already configured windows.
screen.lsmcore.windows.viewer_help: Browse or calculate with New. Only operators may edit the world catalog.
screen.lsmcore.windows.bad_snapshot: Invalid server catalog. Editing and application are disabled until refreshed.
screen.lsmcore.windows.legend: Gold: bounds | Gray: frames | Dashes: Minecraft cells
screen.lsmcore.windows.limits: Policy: total %s x %s; leaves %s; cells %s. Per leaf: 3 x 3.
screen.lsmcore.windows.unchanged: Save this draft before applying it.
window.lsmcore.error.positive_finite: Total width and height must be positive and finite.
window.lsmcore.error.positive_integer: Leaf columns and rows must be positive integers.
window.lsmcore.error.invalid_numbers: Enter finite positive sizes and integer leaf counts.
window.lsmcore.error.leaf_size_limit: A leaf exceeds 3 x 3 blocks. Increase columns or rows.
window.lsmcore.error.frame_clearance: A leaf must be wider and taller than 1/8 block to fit its frame.
window.lsmcore.error.total_limit: The total assembly exceeds the server size limits.
window.lsmcore.error.leaf_count_limit: The leaf count or number of columns/rows exceeds server limits.
window.lsmcore.error.cell_limit: The occupied Minecraft cell count exceeds server limits.
window.lsmcore.error.catalog_limit: The world custom catalog is full.
window.lsmcore.error.protected_catalog: Base layouts cannot be edited, deleted or overwritten.
window.lsmcore.error.permission: You lack operator, building, interaction or owner permissions.
window.lsmcore.error.stale_catalog: The catalog changed. Review the refreshed data and retry.
window.lsmcore.error.unknown_layout: The design was deleted. Existing saved geometry is retained.
window.lsmcore.error.no_target: Look at a compatible assembly before opening this editor to apply.
window.lsmcore.error.no_integration: No owner adapter for this block. Calculation and catalog editing still work.
window.lsmcore.error.target_unavailable: The target moved, is out of reach, unavailable or has invalid saved data.
window.lsmcore.error.surface_too_small: This design does not fit the assembly surface.
window.lsmcore.error.surface_gap: The assembly has missing cells or unavailable glass surface.
window.lsmcore.error.incompatible: Orientation, plane, boundaries, surface or connection policy do not match.
window.lsmcore.error.storage_unavailable: World catalog storage is unavailable. An administrator must inspect the server log.
window.lsmcore.error.integration_error: The owner adapter failed. Inspect the server log before retrying.
window.lsmcore.error.invalid: Invalid parameters. Review the design and server limits.
window.lsmcore.error.assembly_boundary: Connected cells extend beyond the declared assembly boundary.
screen.lsmcore.windows.apply_help: Apply the saved catalog design to this assembly. Server permissions and available surface are checked again.
